week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 9.8 percentage points apart on Buffalo at Minnesota.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 13.2 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: New England's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 63%. San Francisco is the Super Bowl favorite at 13%.
